title: A .netrc credentials file is served
summary: The .netrc file is downloadable, which carries the login and password it uses for other machines in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("machine") and body_contains("password") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the credentials.
